and weather report.

I saw that.
It sounds like tomorrow would be a good day for me to go to the bank.
But we've got a lot to do to get the crops covered today.

Well, lesson learned.

和天气报告。
嗯，看起来我们今天在农场会忙着覆盖作物。
明天预计气温会降到零下 12 度。
